description:
Find served datasets by keyword and return each one's id, title and citation URL, in the shape ChatGPT deep research and company knowledge call search with.
It runs the same search as search_datasets, so every word in query must match. Pass an id to fetch to read the dataset's licence, attribution and newest version. The same id is the slug that list_fields, query_rows and count_rows take.
Up to 50 matches come back in one answer, with no paging.
Each call costs one of the 60 queries each address may make in 10 seconds.

query.description: Words from a title, publisher or field name

name: search

results.description: Matches, best first when the search index is loaded

id.description: The dataset's slug, which fetch takes as id

url.description: The dataset page on publicdata.au, to cite

title: Find datasets to fetch
